 Code Mode (experimental)

 Code Mode lets Claude write and run code to call tools in fewer round trips. It is experimental, and a session
 started with it can be resumed only with Code Mode on.

 ❯ No, start without it
   Yes, turn on Code Mode

 Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
